lines.text: Pharisees and scribes from Jerusalem ask Jesus why His disciples do not wash their hands before they eat.
Jesus says the Pharisees and scribes break God's command to honor father and mother for the sake of their tradition.
Jesus calls them hypocrites and says Moses prophesied that their hearts are far from God.
Jesus tells the crowd that what comes out of the mouth defiles a man, and the Pharisees are offended.
John asks Jesus to explain the parable, and Jesus says evil comes out of the heart, not from unwashed hands.
